rows: Regulatory, compliance and data privacy
Reading a rule, turning it into a checklist, a policy and a training session for a company. Deadlines come from the law, not from a deal.
People who like rules, documents and steady process more than deal adrenaline.
Scalable
Fixed packages: a compliance audit, a policy pack, a monthly retainer for small and mid-size companies.
Startups and venture work
Founder agreements, fundraising documents, employee option plans and the first contracts of a young company. Broad, fast and often thin on process.
People who want business exposure early and can work without a big team around them.
Scalable with a business layer
Fractional or retainer counsel for several young companies at once.
Tax
Advising on how a deal or a structure is taxed, and supporting tax disputes. Heavy on numbers and statute.
People comfortable with both law and accounts, such as a BCom LLB graduate.
Scalable with a business layer
A tax advisory practice for business owners, usually after years inside a firm.
Intellectual property
Filing and protecting patents, trademarks and copyright, plus commercial IP agreements. Patent work often rewards a science or engineering first degree.
Detail-minded people, and graduates who already hold a technical degree.
Scalable with a business layer
A boutique IP firm that runs on filings, renewals and repeat clients.
